title: Multigenerational Family in Cozy Living Room, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A bustling, candid portrait of a multigenerational American family gathered together in a residential living room, matching the handwritten caption at the top margin reading '13 in all.' The thirteen family members range in age from infants and young children to elderly grandparents. Several adults sit on an upholstered sofa and armchair dressed in post-World War II casual and formal attire, including suits, neckties, knit sweaters, and a girl's patterned floral dress. The room is decorated with period Venetian blinds, heavy patterned drapes, a coffee table loaded with magazines, and a decorative fireplace mantle with small ceramics, capturing post-war domestic warmth and familial closeness.
